claims.text: Nimbus 2.0 was published on 2026-03-14 and ships with no runtime dependencies.

evidence.snippet: Release notes dated 2026-03-14 list an empty runtime dependency set.
Nimbus 2.0 is available today, and its runtime dependency list is empty by design.

claims.text: Adoption accelerated after the 2.0 release rather than before it.

evidence.snippet: Downloads tripled in the two weeks following the 2.0 announcement.
Coverage links the jump in interest to the 2.0 announcement.

key_findings.finding: Nimbus 2.0 shipped without runtime dependencies and adoption rose after the release.
